name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift High Pull
steps: Stand over a barbell in a wide stance with toes angled out, push your hips back, and take a narrow overhand grip inside your knees.
Drive through your feet to extend your hips and knees explosively while keeping the bar close to your legs.
As your hips lock out, shrug strongly and pull your elbows high and outside to draw the bar up toward your collarbone.
Lower the bar smoothly back past your hips and hinge down to return it to the floor.
tips: Extend your hips completely before bending your elbows to pull the bar upward.
Keep your elbows higher than your wrists at the top and keep the bar close to your torso.
